title: Professional engineers registration scheme (Victoria)
summary: The Professional Engineers Registration Act 2019 commenced on 1 July 2021, requiring professional engineers in prescribed areas (civil, structural, electrical, mechanical, fire safety) to register, with mandatory registration phased in by discipline to December 2023.

commenced.what: Act came into effect; building-industry engineers must be registered and endorsed
Mandatory registration deadline for electrical engineers

direction_rationale: Mandatory registration in prescribed engineering areas creates a new entry barrier and compliance costs for engineering consultancies.

industries.name: Engineering Design and Engineering Consulting Services

comparison: States without engineer registration (SA, WA, TAS, NT); NSW (class 2 only from 2021)
notes: Other phase-in dates reported in secondary sources: fire safety 1 Dec 2021; civil and structural 1 Oct 2022; mechanical 1 Dec 2023.

verified.notes: Only the 1 Jul 2021 date is from a government source; the 1 Jun 2023 date is from Engineers Australia (professional body) and other phase-in dates are secondary.
